tokens.name: color.surface.base
tokens.description: Page background and the default canvas behind all content. Use once per page, on body.

tokens.name: color.surface.raised
tokens.description: Framed objects that sit on the page: cards, accession labels, the sticky header, table bodies. Never as page background.

tokens.name: color.surface.sunken
tokens.description: Recessed areas that hold machine text: code blocks, inline code, table header rows, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: color.surface.hover
tokens.description: Background of an interactive row or card while hovered. Only as a hover state; never at rest.

tokens.name: color.surface.inverse
tokens.description: Background of tooltips and other small transient labels that must stand out from every surface. Never for panels or cards.

tokens.name: color.surface.highlight
tokens.description: Text selection, <mark>, and the current item in site navigation. Never for large areas or decoration.

tokens.name: color.text.primary
tokens.description: Body copy, headings and any text a reader must read. Default text colour.

tokens.name: color.text.secondary
tokens.description: Supporting reading text: ledes, summaries, captions, blockquotes. Still AAA, so it can carry full sentences.

tokens.name: color.text.muted
tokens.description: Metadata only: dates, reading time, counts, label keys. Never for sentences or body copy (AA, not AAA).

tokens.name: color.text.accent
tokens.description: Short accent text: accession numbers, eyebrow labels, the current nav item. Never for paragraphs; use color.link.* for links.

tokens.name: color.text.inverse
tokens.description: Text on color.surface.inverse (tooltips). Only there.

tokens.name: color.text.on-accent
tokens.description: Text and icons placed on color.accent.fill.*, such as primary button labels. Only on accent fills.

tokens.name: color.link.rest
tokens.description: Inline links in running text. Always underlined so colour is not the only cue.

tokens.name: color.link.hover
tokens.description: Inline link while hovered or focused. Pair with a thicker underline, not colour alone.

tokens.name: color.border.subtle
tokens.description: Decorative dividers inside a component: table row rules, list separators. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: color.border.default
tokens.description: Outlines of non-interactive framed objects: cards, labels, code blocks, figures.

tokens.name: color.border.strong
tokens.description: Boundaries of interactive controls (secondary buttons, inputs, toggles) and hovered card outlines. Meets 3:1 non-text contrast.

tokens.name: color.accent.fill.rest
tokens.description: Fill of the one primary action in a view. One per view; never for large panels.

tokens.name: color.accent.fill.hover
tokens.description: Fill of a primary action while hovered or pressed.

tokens.name: color.accent.border
tokens.description: Accent rules that mark the active item: current nav underline, active TOC entry, hovered tag. Not for static decoration.

tokens.name: color.focus.ring
tokens.description: Keyboard focus outline on every focusable element. Always drawn with border.focus.offset so it sits on the surface, not the control.

tokens.name: color.ornament.rest
tokens.description: Yarndings ornaments and the specimen plate's contour lines. Decorative only: always aria-hidden, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: color.ornament.strong
tokens.description: Emphasised stitches that trace structure inside an ornament, and the plate's index contours (every fifth line). Decorative only; never for text.

tokens.name: color.ornament.muted
tokens.description: Registration ticks on framed objects and the plate's survey grid. Decorative only; no contrast requirement.

tokens.name: color.backdrop.tint
tokens.description: Share of color.surface.base laid over the blurred backdrop contours, in percent: enough to soften the lines into relief behind the header, the opening of a page and the footer.

tokens.name: color.backdrop.grain
tokens.description: Opacity of the monochrome grain over the frost, in percent. Texture only; never raise it until it competes with text.

tokens.name: color.backdrop.saturation
tokens.description: Saturation applied with the frost blur, in percent, so blurred contour colour stays green instead of greying out.

tokens.name: color.wash.hover

tokens.name: motion.duration.instant
tokens.description: Theme changes, focus rings, and every duration under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion.duration.fast
tokens.description: Hover and press feedback: colour, border, the button-arrow nudge.

tokens.name: motion.duration.base
tokens.description: Disclosures (details, TOC) and the active-section marker.

tokens.name: motion.duration.slow
tokens.description: One-off confirmations such as a copied state settling. Rare.

tokens.name: motion.duration.plate
tokens.description: The specimen plate's single draw-in on load. Decoration only; never for content.

tokens.name: motion.duration.drift
tokens.description: Time the contour terrain (the backdrop, or the specimen plate) takes to drift one noise unit, so its lines reshape slowly and continuously. The only looping motion in the system: one contour field per page, with a visible pause control, stopped under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion.duration.pulse
tokens.description: One full cycle of the specimen plate's outward pulse. The only looping motion in the system; it must have a visible pause control and stop under prefers-reduced-motion.
tokens.deprecated: Unused since the contour plate; removed in 2.0.0.

tokens.name: motion.easing.standard
tokens.description: Default for state changes.

tokens.name: motion.easing.enter
tokens.description: Elements appearing: disclosures opening, a toast arriving.

tokens.name: motion.easing.exit
tokens.description: Elements leaving.

tokens.name: motion.easing.linear
tokens.description: Staggered decoration (the plate's contour draw-in) and progress only. The plate's drift is linear too.

tokens.name: motion.easing.pulse
tokens.description: Symmetric ease for looping decoration (the plate pulse), so growth and shrink feel even. Never for state changes.
tokens.deprecated: Unused since the contour plate; removed in 2.0.0.

tokens.name: motion.distance.nudge
tokens.description: The only allowed translation: a button arrow moving forward on hover. Text never moves.

tokens.name: size.breakpoint.md
tokens.description: Width below which a layout counts as a phone. For width media queries only: write @media (width < token(size.breakpoint.md)) in css/components.css and the build fills in the value, because custom properties cannot be used in @media. Prefer intrinsic layouts; use it to choose between alternate content, such as the case study's lead label and card.

tokens.name: size.breakpoint.lg

tokens.name: size.backdrop.blur
tokens.description: Blur radius of the frost over the backdrop contours. Wide enough that the lines read as soft relief, never as text-like strokes behind the header and footer.

tokens.name: size.backdrop.fade
tokens.description: Length of the fade at the top and bottom of a backdrop page, over which the page surface gives way to the frost. The header and the opening statement sit inside it; reading text below it is on the plain surface.

tokens.name: size.backdrop.height
tokens.description: Height of the backdrop layer before its blur overhang: the large viewport, so the contours keep their size and position as a phone's address bar slides away. Never a dynamic or small viewport unit, which resize the layer as you scroll and make the contours jump.

groups.botanical: Plants and flowers. The default choice for end marks, empty states and dividers.
groups.frost: Snowflakes, stars and bursts. Use one at a time; they are dense and draw the eye.

groups.mark: Corners, bars, dots and triangles. Structural accents: registration corners, rules, list ends.

forbidden.reason: Faces, a robot, hearts and animals read as emoji. Never use them.
